construction.implementation_origin: Written from scratch in the isolated build directory

shared_schema.constraints: Unknown fields rejected. Catalog <=10000 items, events <=100000. Limit integer 0..1000. Half-life 0.001..36500 days; popularity weight 0..1. Booleans are not numbers.
shared_schema.validation: One validate function used by discover and CLI; JSON decoding additionally rejects duplicate keys. Input and file errors exit 2 with one JSON object.

behavior.recency: event weight = action multiplier * 2^(-age_days/half_life_days), browse=1, purchase=3; age relative to explicit as_of
behavior.personalization: Only requested user's events contribute. Item affinity and category affinity normalized by total user event weight.
behavior.cold_start: No effective history (including numerical underflow): rank by popularity alone.
behavior.eligibility: Only available catalog items returned. Previously purchased or browsed items remain eligible. Unavailable items may still inform history.
behavior.determinism: Events accumulated in event_id order; descending unrounded score, then ascending item_id; output numbers rounded to 12 decimals.
behavior.fixtures: example_input.json and all test fixtures are explicitly synthetic
